By using Google Apps Script for automation, Cloudflare Workers for webhook handling, and Supabase for order storage, creators can process orders in under 30 seconds and automatically send download links to customers after a crypto payment confirms. How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this architecture is Google Apps Script, which handles the logic of order processing and fulfillment. When a customer makes a payment, a webhook event is triggered, which Cloudflare Workers handles in real-time. This means that orders can be processed and fulfilled in under 30 seconds, without any manual intervention required. Supabase is used for order storage, providing a secure and scalable database that can handle high volumes of orders and customer data. By using these three components together, creators can automate their entire digital commerce workflow, from payment processing to order fulfillment and customer support.
